summary: Limit decimal precision in a numeric report.
documentation: SQLite round returns a floating-point value rounded to a requested number of decimal places. Omitting digits uses zero; negative precision is treated as zero. NULL arguments produce NULL.
inputs: A numeric expression and optional decimal precision.
returns: A rounded floating-point number, or NULL.
caution: Floating-point rounding is not an exact decimal accounting system. Keep money in integer minor units when exact arithmetic is required.
scenarios: Reduce precision of average trip durations in a report.
Format a measurement estimate for a dashboard.
Make summary percentages easier to scan.
title: Round delivery duration estimates
problem: From estimates(id INTEGER, hours REAL), return id and round(hours, 1) as rounded_hours, ordered by id. Keep NULL as NULL. Tests avoid ambiguous binary halfway values.
goal: Use round() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Request one decimal place and give the result its required alias.
